{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Inspect the data
print("Shape:", df.shape)
print("\nColumns:", df.columns.tolist())
print("\nFirst few rows:\n", df.head(3).to_string(index=False))

# Check for duplicates in patient_id
print("\nNumber of unique patient_id:", df['patient_id'].nunique())
print("Total rows:", len(df))
print("Duplicate patient_id count:", len(df) - df['patient_id'].nunique())

# Check for -999 in biomarker_baseline
print("\nNumber of -999 in biomarker_baseline:", (df['biomarker_baseline'] == -999).sum())

# Check assay_batch values
print("\nUnique assay_batch values:", df['assay_batch'].unique())

# Check arm and severity distributions
table_arm_severity = pd.crosstab(df['arm'], df['severity'])
print("\nArm vs Severity table:\n", table_arm_severity)

# Check sample_seq distribution per patient
print("\nMax sample_seq per patient:", df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].max().value_counts().sort_index())"}
